summary: A Monday slate of closing league fixtures plus ATP Shanghai and WTA Wuhan tennis; kept legs (Atalanta, Famalicão, Fils, Chwalinska, Eala, Shnaider) are trimmed toward slightly lower bookmaker prices. Most other legs are excluded for unconfirmed key availability (Newcastle, Udinese/Torino, Sevilla) or for being Challenger/WTA 125 tennis and non-tier-1 esports qualifiers.

verdicts.reason: Key availability unconfirmed: Jaissle said only 'three or four back from the nine missing' without naming them, with Burn, Dedić, Livramento, Ramsey, Elanga, Osula and Joelinton all doubtful and keeper Jaouen out (newcastleunited.com, FantasyFootballScout); PL GW6 fixture confirmed (Premier League API).
verdicts.main_risk: A depleted Newcastle, beaten 4-1 at Leeds, lose to a Coventry side that just won at Forest.

verdicts.reason: Key availability unconfirmed: the leg depends on which of Newcastle's nine absentees return (Jaissle presser), and Coventry's van Ewijk and Kesler-Hayden have uncertain match fitness with Awoniyi suspended (FantasyFootballScout).
verdicts.main_risk: Newcastle get Burn, Joelinton and Dedić back and their quality wins it.

verdicts.reason: Key availability unconfirmed: Sevilla's main striker Stassin didn't train Sunday with a decision 'hasta el último segundo' and Ure's start conflicts across sources (El Gol Digital, Comuniate); LaLiga MD8 confirmed (ESPN 401882852); DraftKings de-vig 0.653 ≈ market.
verdicts.main_risk: 5th-placed, unbeaten-away Sevilla beat a bottom-three Levante defence.

verdicts.reason: Key availability unconfirmed: Stassin a last-minute decision, Iker Muñoz missed training, Vargas only fit for the bench (El Gol Digital); Levante's Etta Eyong 'muy al límite' (Comuniate); DraftKings de-vig 0.640 ≈ market.
verdicts.main_risk: Levante's home H2H edge (2-0 and 3-0 last season) holds against a Sevilla side without a recognised No. 9.

verdicts.reason: Both teams far outside the HLTV top 30: RUSTEC ranked #117 in June 2026 (dust2.us) and NPG built on the AM roster, ~79th in Valve's VRS; open-qualifier fixture not independently confirmed.
verdicts.main_risk: Low-tier, unstable rosters with possible stand-ins.

verdicts.reason: Outside the HLTV top 30 / unverifiable: Johnny Speeds ranked #79 in June (dust2.us) and 'PRIVATE' could not be identified after two searches.
verdicts.main_risk: Unknown roster for 'PRIVATE'.

verdicts.reason: Outside the HLTV top 30: GenOne ranked #53-65 (dust2.us, July 2026) and ACIDHOUZE could not be found at all.
verdicts.main_risk: Unknown opponent and unstable lower-tier rosters.

verdicts.reason: Not tier-1: LGC Rising is Riot's EMEA women's League of Legends competition (lolesports.com, rft.gg) and SK Gaming Avarosa is SK's women's programme (Dexerto); the LEC is the tier-1 league and women's sides are excluded.
verdicts.main_risk: Volatile, low-data scene with frequent roster changes.

verdicts.reason: Not tier-1: Monsters Reloaded Closed Qualifier is a $3,000 third-party qualifier outside VCT (TheSpike, re-read today).
verdicts.main_risk: Stand-ins or academy lineups at short notice in a low-stakes qualifier.

verdicts.reason: Serie A MD6 confirmed (ESPN 401875005); bottom-placed Venezia (0 pts) miss captain Busio and six others, but Atalanta have lost three straight, 12 internationals only rejoined on Thursday and Pafos (UCL) follows on Thursday (Bergamonews, Tuttosport); DraftKings de-vig 0.618, just below market.
verdicts.main_risk: Atalanta's slump and post-break fatigue produce a draw against a Venezia side playing for Stroppa's job.

verdicts.reason: Key availability unconfirmed in this game: Runjaic does not know if Udinese's Alaba plays and Davis lacks 90 minutes (TuttoUdinese), while Torino's Adams is short of fitness (Abate presser); DraftKings de-vig 0.703 ≈ market.
verdicts.main_risk: Torino's under-trained defence makes individual errors in a near coin-flip game.

verdicts.reason: Key availability unconfirmed: Alaba a game-time decision and Davis not fit for 90 minutes (Runjaic presser), with Zaniolo, Gueye and Piotrowski out; DraftKings de-vig 0.599 ≈ market, so no value to offset the uncertainty.
verdicts.main_risk: Udinese's depleted attack fails to score and Torino win at home.

verdicts.reason: Primeira Liga MD8 Monday game confirmed (ESPN 401885425, Lusa, SAPO); Famalicão unbeaten in four with 7 conceded and only suspended Beney out (SAPO/Zerozero); Alverca miss three with three more doubtful (A Bola); DraftKings de-vig 0.786 and Foresportia 0.775, just below market.
verdicts.main_risk: In-form Alverca (two straight wins) win on the break against a Famalicão side with seven internationals just back.

verdicts.reason: Famalicão have won once in seven (four draws) while Alverca won two straight; DraftKings de-vig 0.504 and Foresportia 0.461 below market, Under 2.5 favoured at -130; Carvalhal called the break 'altamente negativa' with seven internationals just returned (Bola na Rede, SAPO).
verdicts.main_risk: A low-scoring draw against an Alverca side sitting deep in a 5-4-1.

verdicts.reason: Official OP: Fils [8] v Van de Zandschulp 4th on Grandstand 2 (~09:15 UTC or later); Fils in form (Cincinnati title, Tokyo QF) and leads H2H 1-0, but book average 1.22/4.26 (~77.7%) and String Tension Elo 59.7% sit below the 79.5% market.
verdicts.main_risk: An in-form Van de Zandschulp (US Open QF), or Fils's fitness history (retired at Rome in May, 2025 back stress fracture).

verdicts.reason: WTA 1000 Wuhan R64 confirmed on the revised main draw; Sherif hasn't played since a 1-6 2-6 US Open loss on 2 Sep, but Chwalinska lost 3-6 1-6 in Beijing R2 and book average 4.09/1.23 (~76.9%) sits below the 79.5% market; H2H 1-1.
verdicts.main_risk: Chwalinska's uneven hard-court form since her Wimbledon ankle injury against a rested Sherif.

verdicts.reason: Main draw (not qualifying): Eala [13] v qualifier Shi Han on Center Court after 11:30 UTC (official OP, MDS); Shi Han beat top qualifying seed Stearns and Rakhimova at home, while Eala lost as a 1.17 favourite in Singapore; book average ~77.0% with 1xBet drifting toward Shi.
verdicts.main_risk: An in-form home qualifier upsets a shaky Eala at night.

verdicts.reason: Wuhan R64 confirmed (main draw); Shnaider [11] leads Boulter 2-0 and Boulter has lost 7 of her last 9; book average 3.91/1.25 (~75.8%) slightly below the 77.5% market; no injury news.
verdicts.main_risk: Boulter's serve on a fast court in a Shnaider match that goes to three sets.
